title: Task list
description: The agent's plan: steps with a status mark (chưa làm, đang làm, xong, lỗi, bỏ qua), an optional line under each, and a progress count.
when: Multi-step agent work (plans, migrations, onboarding jobs) people watch progress on.
a11y: An ordered list; each step's status is also text (visually hidden); the running step has aria-current="step".
